title: Analytics dashboard revamp
summary: The analytics page has been redesigned with a richer dashboard layout, clearer KPI summaries, and improved visual highlights.
changes: The analytics dashboard now uses a richer layout with clearer KPI summaries, grouped charts, and stronger visual highlights.
A loading spinner is shown while analytics data is being fetched.
Date range filter and forecast horizon selection have been enhanced.
Metrics display updated with improved visual elements and responsive design.
